summary.note: FP8 GEMM is the sole exact external comparison. A common linked harness gives both implementations identical data, outputs, cache state, stream, HIP-event timer, warmups, run order, and oracle; fe2o3 wins all three fresh processes under both isolated-dispatch and queue-hot timing. The other 19 tutorials still have no exact public comparator.

operators.reason: Packed MXFP4, block scales, BF16 output, and ABI differ from logical-byte E2M1 to FP32.
